meta.title: Odisha's long-run gains in survival, care and living standards
meta.reference: Mohanty, S. K., Kundu, A. and Jagadananda (2026). Population Dynamics and Development Prospects of Odisha: A Roadmap to 2036 and 2047. CYSD and UNFPA (revised paper, 13 November 2026).
meta.short: CYSD and UNFPA, Population Dynamics and Development Prospects of Odisha: A Roadmap to 2036 and 2047 (2026)
notes: Each row gives the earlier and the latest value as reported in the paper, with the primary source the paper cites.
polarity: 1 higher is better, -1 lower is better.

gains.name: Infant deaths
gains.say: Far fewer babies die before their first birthday than a generation ago.

gains.name: Maternal deaths
gains.say: Childbirth is far safer for mothers, and the pace of the last two decades points to further gains.

gains.name: Life expectancy at birth
gains.say: People in Odisha now live about seventeen years longer, with gains at every age.
gains.source: Sample Registration System, Abridged Life Tables

gains.name: Births in a health facility
gains.say: Almost every birth now takes place with care at hand, a strong base for mothers and newborns.
gains.source: As reported in CYSD and UNFPA (2026); 2023–24 from NFHS-6

gains.name: People in multidimensional poverty
gains.say: Fewer than one in six people are now poor across health, education and living standards, from nearly two in three.
gains.source: Alkire et al. (2021); NITI Aayog, National Multidimensional Poverty Index 2023

gains.name: Children per woman
gains.say: Odisha reached the replacement level of 2.1 around 2013, about six years ahead of India as a whole.
